# Bishop of Wings
# s1: Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 4 life.
# s2: Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
_angel_you_control = FAnd(children=(
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Angel'),
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
))
enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=_angel_you_control,
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=4), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=_angel_you_control),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Spirit',
            type_line='Creature — Spirit',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Spirit',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('W',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [enters, dies, *compiled]
